reason: I do not have money for a monthly subscription. My parents pay for everything, and INR 299 a month on top of hostel costs is more than I can ask them for, especially when I am not sure it will get me a service-company offer.
objection: The paid parts (AI mentor, resume tools, plan refreshes) are promised, but the hidden-test checking is not out yet, and the Wi-Fi in my hostel is unreliable, so I would be paying for something I cannot yet use properly.
would_change_my_mind: A free version that covers enough aptitude and DBMS practice to show real progress, or a small one-time payment just for placement season instead of a monthly charge.
